taste.name: Corners, Not Cards
taste.trigger: When the key figures needed grouping
taste.decision: Chose L-shaped corner brackets and a hairline baseline over filled or bordered cards
taste.reason: Brackets frame a region like a viewfinder; the field stays continuous and figures read as readouts

taste.name: Monospace Is the Instrument Voice
taste.trigger: When setting navigation, actions and numbers
taste.decision: Chose monospace for all UI and data strings over one sans for everything
taste.reason: Fixed-width digits and labels read as machine output, which is the product's promise

taste.name: Green Only Where You Can Go
taste.decision: Chose mint #00EB9B on 3 elements over an untinted gray ground, over a branded or tinted palette
taste.reason: Against pure gray, green carries one meaning: action or current place
evidence: mint on active nav, sign-in, primary button

taste.name: Square and Flat
taste.trigger: When styling the primary button and regions
taste.decision: Chose zero radius and no shadow over rounded raised controls
taste.reason: Hard edges read as precision; the page reads as a terminal
